## Before you start project work

- [ ] Any required training is done (your supervisor will tell you which, if any)
- [ ] You've read the instructions for your specific task
- [ ] You know who to ask, and how
- [ ] You can explain in one sentence what the project does and what isn't built yet
- [ ] You can explain why exposure matters (module 4)
- [ ] You can explain why labelers work blind and follow "label only what you see" (module 6)
- [ ] You know the data rules: no screenshots, no saving or sharing images, no trying to locate images (module 7)
